about: Cost model and tradeable-list thresholds (bullet, dated). On trial from 13 Nov 2026 (the first entry applies to every past day too, so history is judged by the same rules): the list is computed and shown, it does not yet block any alert or paper trade. Changing a value needs Mandeep's say-so and a CHANGELOG line.

entries.why: Round trip = spread + 1 extra tick + charges + 60 minutes of ATM theta. 6% is about twice the Nifty / Bank Nifty round trip seen in the 5-year Lab (random buy -1.7% to -3.1%); a setup must beat the cost before it can earn.
